title: Arkret HTTP Problem Details
description: Canonical RFC 9457 application/problem+json error response. The type URI is the stable machine discriminator and must resolve through error-code-registry.json. Unknown extension members are tolerated by consumers as required by RFC 9457; producers may emit only extensions registered for the selected type.
